description: This file defines a PHP class named Topic, which is part of the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class is responsible for managing tasks related to catalog topics within the admin controller context, including adding tasks to clear, list, and get info about topics.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for managing catalog topic tasks in the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds various tasks related to catalog topics, including clearing old data, listing topics, and retrieving information about each topic.
